DopeFlipper is a CK42X pocket market game for Flipper Zero. Travel between boroughs, watch changing prices, manage cash and debt, and try to finish the run with the highest net worth.

The app includes local saves, local stats, heat and cop events, simple sound cues, and an opt-in profile export for the CK42X leaderboard bridge at ck42x.com/dopeflipper. Scores are checked server-side for consistency, but the export is tamper-resistant rather than cheat-proof.
